prompt:
Our agent infrastructure team at FinCore is bleeding money on API token costs — we're 23% over our weekly budget. We have a workspace at /agent-workspace that contains our agents' memory files and a bunch of raw session transcript logs that have never been processed.

I need you to do three things to that workspace:
1. Process all the raw session transcripts into compact observation summaries.
2. Apply dictionary-based encoding to the memory files to shrink repeated terminology.
3. Generate the tiered summary files so sub-agents can do a quick cold-start load.

One important detail: our internal tooling uses a non-standard tokenizer that operates at 3.5 characters per token (not the usual 4). Make sure the compression system knows about this before you run anything, otherwise the token budgets for the summary tiers will be calibrated wrong.

The compression tool is already installed at /opt/claw-compactor. Please set it up and run the full pipeline on /agent-workspace.
